title: remove_yaml_field
description: Removes a field at a specified path from a YAML file, leaving the rest of the document intact.

file_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the YAML file to modify (e.g. 'config/app.yaml', 'k8s/deployment.yaml').

field_path.description: Dot-separated path to the field to remove from the YAML document (e.g. 'spec.tolerations', 'metadata.annotations.deprecated-key').
